description: Table 1 is rendered as a single horizontal image and is a two-row composition table for the investigated Fe–8% Al alloy; there are no micrographs, curves or plots. The header row lists five element/column entries exactly as printed: "Al", "Mn", "C", "Ti + Nb + V", and "Fe". The left-hand stub of the second row gives the unit as "10⁻³ wt.%", so every numeric cell is expressed in 10⁻³ wt.%. The data row reads Al = 8150, Mn = 100, C = 8.6, Ti + Nb + V = "<100" (an upper bound, not an exact value), and Fe = "Bal." (balance), i.e. approximately 8.15 wt.% Al, 0.10 wt.% Mn, 0.0086 wt.% C and <0.10 wt.% Ti+Nb+V, with Fe making up the remainder. Reading the unit literally, the table states the alloy's chemical composition in 10⁻³ wt.%. A short stray fragment "a. ε = 1" precedes the table in the caption text and does not correspond to anything in the table image itself. No error bars, ranges, or measurement conditions other than the unit appear in the table.

observations.observation: The table has a header row listing the column entries 'Al', 'Mn', 'C', 'Ti + Nb + V' and 'Fe' beside a left stub labelled 'Composition'.
The unit row stub is printed as '10⁻³ wt.%', i.e. all numeric values are given in 10⁻³ wt.%.
The tabulated values are Al = 8150, Mn = 100, C = 8.6, Ti + Nb + V = <100 and Fe = Bal.
The Ti + Nb + V value is printed as '<100', i.e. an upper bound rather than a measured exact content.
Fe is given as 'Bal.' (balance), so it is not quantified numerically in the table.
Converting the printed 10⁻³ wt.% values, the alloy contains approximately 8.15 wt.% Al, 0.10 wt.% Mn, 0.0086 wt.% C and <0.10 wt.% Ti + Nb + V.
The caption identifies this as Table 1, the chemical composition of the investigated Fe–8% Al alloy.
The citing text states the ferritic Fe–8% Al alloy was supplied by ArcelorMittal Maizières and rolled in three successive passes with a cumulative deformation equal to 1.
The caption text preceding the table contains the stray fragment 'a. ε = 1', which does not describe any content visible in the table image.
